meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: AI agents and automation for hotel front desk, guest service, and staffing operations

analysis.summary: Rivals mostly refresh old pages instead of publishing new ones. Dextr published 2 new pages, but none of them explain its AI agents or show staffing results.

points.text: ALICE leads on original research, with 7 of its 15 recent pages on labor costs and profitability reports.
Duve updated 9 product landing pages and published nothing new, which looks like a push to refresh its sales pages.
Dextr's two new pages are a partner news post and a blog index page. It has no published how-to, research or case study content in this period.

Dextr.play: Announced a Cloudbeds partnership and launched a blog index page. Little else is new.

Canary Technologies.play: No page activity in 30 days. Its 233 templated /post/ pages show a large blog archive.

ALICE (Actabl).play: Pushes labor and profitability research, connected-hotel guides, and AI labor savings news.

Akia.play: Updated an automation-priorities guide and launched an AI agent landing page.

Duve.play: Refreshed 9 landing pages for guest app, messaging, upsell and AI products.
Duve.aimed: Hotels ready to buy guest software

Operto.play: Refreshed product and checklist pages, plus one new OTA research report.

shared.title: Refresh over new
shared.text: Duve (13 updates, 0 new), Operto (8 updates, 1 new) and ALICE (9 updates, 6 new) mostly edited old pages. Expect fewer new pages and more polish of existing ones.

shared.title: Guides for early-stage buyers
shared.text: Akia, ALICE and Operto publish how-to guides and checklists on what to automate or connect. They aim to reach hotels still learning.

gaps.title: AI agent proof for front desk
gaps.text: Nobody here shows results from an AI agent at the front desk. Only Akia has a new AI agent page, and it is a landing page.

gaps.title: Staffing automation guides
gaps.text: ALICE owns labor-cost reports, but nobody covers using AI agents to cover shifts and ease staff workload in a how-to format.

gaps.title: Partner integration playbooks
gaps.text: Only Dextr has a partner post. A step-by-step guide on connecting AI to Cloudbeds and similar systems is open to own.

versus.Canary Technologies: Shows no recent activity, though it has a big blog archive. Dextr is more active now but has far less content.
versus.ALICE (Actabl): Publishes research, guides and case studies for learners. Dextr has one news post and a blog index, and no research.
versus.Akia: Akia has an AI agent landing page and an automation guide. Dextr has neither a guide nor a product-focused page this period.
versus.Duve: Duve updates many product pages for buyers. Dextr has no product pages in recent activity and leans on partner news.
versus.Operto: Operto mixes product pages, checklists and a research report. Dextr publishes less and has no tools or downloads.
